Load FAO Global Capture Production Data

Source: R/fao_data_update.R
load_fao_data.Rd

This function loads a release downloaded with download_fao_data(), or the data bundled with the package.

Usage

load_fao_data(version = "latest", data_dir = fao_data_dir())

Arguments

version

The release to load, e.g. "2026.1.0". Default is "latest", the newest of the downloaded releases and the bundled data. Use "bundled" for the data bundled with the package.

data_dir

The directory where downloaded releases are stored. Default is fao_data_dir().

Value

A data frame with the columns of Global_Production_long.

See also

Other FAO data: check_fao_update(), download_fao_data(), fao_data_dir(), fao_data_info()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
data <- load_fao_data()
FAO34 <- subset(data, FAO.major.fishing.area..Name. == "Atlantic, Eastern Central")
} # }
